[
  "What is the total MRR across all active subscriptions, broken down by Plan, and which Plan contributes the most to overall MRR?",
  "How many subscriptions are in each Status (e.g., active, canceled, trialing), and for the canceled ones, what are the most common Cancellation Reasons and what share of MRR did they represent?",
  "What is the Average Revenue Per Account (ARPA) by Plan and by Interval (monthly vs. annual), and which combination drives the highest Amount per subscription?",
  "How many subscriptions are flagged with Cancel At Period End set to true, and what is the MRR at risk from those subscriptions broken down by Plan?",
  "Which subscriptions have a Coupon or Percent Off applied, how does their Average Amount and MRR compare to non-discounted subscriptions, and are discounted customers concentrated in any particular Plan or Status?"
]
